description: Values read and verified from the Semantic Scholar search, held back from operating_ranges.json until their journals pass the venue check. Each sentence has been read and judged exactly as for the main file; what is still missing is scripts/check_venues.py, which needs the OpenAlex budget that resets at midnight UTC. Only values whose DOI's journal comes back as core are merged.
rejected_note: Rejected in this pass: engine-out unburned ammonia read as stack slip (10.3390/en18143631, 16016 to 100 ppm is the engine, not the funnel); a sensor's measuring range read as slip; efficiencies inside recirculation sentences; an ASC reactivation temperature read as an operating one; and an unoptimised SCR baseline of 122 ppm slip (10.3390/pr12071519), kept out because it is the deliberately poor reference the paper improves on, not a design point. Current density: electrolysis values (SOEC, AEMWE, PCEC in electrolysis mode, co-electrolysis) and electrocatalytic ammonia synthesis and NOx reduction were rejected; a cell voltage above about 1.2 V marks electrolysis. Two operating points whose device the sentence does not name were rejected rather than guessed.
